# Formula Formatting

## Original

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}
2x_1+3x_2-x_3 &= 5 \\
4x_1-x_2+2x_3 &= 6 \\
-x_1+2x_2+3x_3 &= 1
\end{aligned}\right.
$$

## Red And Bold

$$
\textcolor{#e74c3c}{
\pmb{
\left\{\begin{aligned}
2x_1+3x_2-x_3 &= 5 \\
4x_1-x_2+2x_3 &= 6 \\
-x_1+2x_2+3x_3 &= 1
\end{aligned}\right.
}
}
$$

## Blue Matrix

$$
\textcolor{#3498db}{
\pmb{
A=\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 2 & 3 \\
4 & 5 & 6 \\
7 & 8 & 9
\end{pmatrix}
}
}
$$

Following text stays unchanged when formatting a formula.
